name: Ferienhaus Bollbichl
beschreibung:
Quietly perched in a sunny secluded setting on the plateau of Schwoich, Ferienhaus Bollbichl enchants guests with panoramic views of the Kaiser mountains. The expansive property offers generous space and privacy for families and groups.

The surrounding countryside invites peaceful strolls, cycling tours, and swimming in nearby forest lakes, with historic Kufstein just a few kilometres away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Bollbichl in Schwoich offers rural serenity and spacious accommodations in the scenic Kufsteinerland.
